method: Native stereo float PCM; exact sample/rail, DC, derivative, quiet-window, spectral and trim/crossfade screening. All candidates require listening; no claim to remove baked-in source distortion.

loop.simulation: Linear 0.8s ramps at exact trim points; not a captured browser render. Native loop when crossfade=0. Jitter/codec buffering need real-browser/device listening.

files.noiseAssessment: Unknown: musical tails, intentional distortion and noise textures cannot be separated from unwanted noise by these statistics.
files.eqDecision: No automatic EQ or denoise from energy/tonality alone. Retain original until matched-level listening identifies a specific defect.
